R.rule: R — Resolution robustness. Every honest cell of every confirmatory reference is classified raw vs resolution-matched (resolution.match_effective_resolution) as unchanged, stabilised, destabilised, reversed, membership_changed or error (panel_v3.classify_resolution_change). Not supported if any cell is reversed (the nearest candidate changed). Supported otherwise. Inconclusive if the resolution control was not run or any classified cell is an error.

S.reason: 3 of 3 confirmatory plains references hold S (>= 2 required): ['mars_arcadia', 'mars_cerberus', 'mars_solis']
S.rule: S — Smoothness / shortlist. The nearest Earth candidate tracks km-scale smoothness, not volcanic origin. Supported if ≥ 2 of the 3 confirmatory volcanic_plains references have expectation S (class_in_layer1: some smooth_control candidate is in the baseline Pareto layer 1) with outcome holds (satisfied at every honest support). Not supported if ≤ 1. Inconclusive if the panel does not have exactly 3 confirmatory volcanic_plains references, or any of their honest cells is an ERROR.

V.reason: only 0 of 3 confirmatory plains references hold V (>= 2 required); V holds for every confirmatory highland reference -- the basaltic advantage is not specific to volcanic plains
V.rule: V — Volcanic specificity. Supported if ≥ 2 of the 3 confirmatory volcanic_plains references have expectation V (class_dominates: some basaltic candidate Pareto-dominates every smooth_control candidate) with outcome holds, and ≥ 1 of the 2 confirmatory highland references has expectation V with an outcome other than holds. Not supported otherwise. Inconclusive if the panel does not have exactly 3 confirmatory volcanic_plains and 2 confirmatory highland references, or any of their honest cells is an ERROR.

hypotheses.evidence_rule: Evidence: honest supports only (at or above the support floor), core lens, confirmatory references only; exploratory and calibration references are reported but never counted. limitations: Not independent replications: all Mars references share one source (MOLA) and all Earth candidates share one (COP30); references × honest supports are multiple comparisons, reported as such, with no correction applied.
COP30 is a surface model (DSM), not bare earth: it includes vegetation and buildings. The chosen areas are sparsely built and vegetated; this is a stated limitation, not a correction.
Representativeness: each window samples a small part of a named unit; coordinates are approximate named-feature centres, some taken from secondary sources.
The 3× effective-resolution figure is a heuristic, not a measured MOLA transfer function; the resolution control equalises resolving power under that heuristic and adds no information.

Candidate classes (basaltic / smooth_control / others) are assigned from the literature before the run. S and V test class-level Pareto relations of map-scale morphology descriptors; they read the baseline frontier, so they can hold in TIE or INDETERMINATE cells and are not recommendations.
Morphology only: no traversability, geologic-equivalence, process, site-access, or mission claim.
